description: Anthony & Dominic's 2018 Pinot Noir is a fruit-led California expression with bright red berries, supple texture, and softly integrated oak. In three-liter format, it is designed for generous service while retaining Pinot Noir's natural freshness.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 3-liter 2018 Anthony & Dominic Pinot Noir from Napa Valley.
palate: Supple red fruit, gentle oak, fresh acidity
sommelierNotes: Serve lightly cool and allow the large format to open in the glass; pair with salmon, roast poultry, or herb-roasted pork.
